Trial_Structure.Stimulus_duration: Until response or maximum 1500 ms (shape-label pair)
Trial_Structure.ITI: 500 ms black screen at trial start
Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: / (feedback 'incorrect'/'please respond faster' on error or timeout)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: Geometric shapes (circle Kreis.png and triangle Dreieck.png), approx 5 degrees x 5 degrees visual angle
Stimulus_Properties.Label: German words: Ich (I), Fremder (stranger); Courier New 18-pt, approx 0.7 degrees visual angle

exp1.detail: Study 1: dot-probe task with short SOA (100 ms) presented before the matching task. Matching task: 4 practice + 128 trials, keys d (match) / k (nonmatch), response deadline 1500 ms with feedback. Data: 38 participants x 128 trials (rawData: conjunctSPE_short-XX-XX txt exports from OSF 3ke4f). Paper analysis N=34 (SPSS FILTER excludes Subjects 19/20/23/28, dot-probe RT outliers). Shape identity (self/stranger) derived from matching-trial shape-label correspondence (counterbalanced); verified against paper statistics (all F values reproduced exactly, see 2_Code/orellana2020_verify). Paper methods describe shapes as square and triangle but stimulus files are Kreis.png (circle) / Dreieck.png (triangle) - data take precedence (same deviation as Orellana-Corrales_2021_APP). Source: paper full text (PDF) + OSF 3ke4f raw exports; [P] paper, [D] data.
